# genesyscloud_webdeployments_deployment_identity_resolution (Resource)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/resources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Genesys Cloud web deployment identity resolution config

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this resource. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [GET /api/v2/webdeployments/deployments](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-webdeployments-deployments)
* [GET /api/v2/webdeployments/deployments/{deploymentId}/identityresolution](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-webdeployments-deployments--deploymentId--identityresolution)
* [PUT /api/v2/webdeployments/deployments/{deploymentId}/identityresolution](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#put-api-v2-webdeployments-deployments--deploymentId--identityresolution)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `webDeployments:deployment:edit`
* `webDeployments:deployment:view`
* `webDeployments:identityResolution:edit`
* `webDeployments:identityResolution:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `webdeployments`
* `webdeployments:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "genesyscloud_webdeployments_deployment_identity_resolution" "example_deployment_identity_resolution" {
  deployment_id      = genesyscloud_webdeployments_deployment.example_deployment.id
  resolve_identities = true
  division_id        = data.genesyscloud_auth_division_home.home.id
  automerge_config {
    # Both flags are required whenever this block is present. Enabling
    # authenticated_web_messaging additionally requires authentication_settings with
    # enabled = true on the deployment's configuration, otherwise the platform silently
    # refuses it and the apply fails.
    authenticated_web_messaging = false
    web_tracking                = true
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_id` (String) ID of the web deployment this identity resolution config belongs to.
- `resolve_identities` (Boolean) Whether identities should be resolved.

### Optional

- `automerge_config` (Block List, Max: 1) Whether automerging of contacts should be enabled for each channel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--automerge_config))
- `division_id` (String) The division to use when performing identity resolution. If not set, * means the unassigned (star) division. '*' may also be set explicitly for the same behavior.
- `external_source_id` (String) The external source used for stitching this channel.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--automerge_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `automerge_config`

Required:

- `authenticated_web_messaging` (Boolean) Whether automerging is enabled for Authenticated Webmessaging conversations in this channel.
- `web_tracking` (Boolean) Whether automerging is enabled for Web Tracking sessions in this channel.
